youtube.title: The Extra Hole On Your Sneakers (Try It In 30 Seconds)
youtube.description: Look at the top of your sneakers: that extra eyelet was probably never used for its real job. It's a heel lock, a loop trick runners and hikers use to cut heel slip, a common contributor to blisters and black toenails. The hidden why: it pins your heel without squeezing the rest of your foot. It takes about 30 seconds to try on the shoes you're wearing. #TheHiddenWhy #facts #explained
